Web design Shreveport businesses get real value from starts with the river. Shreveport sits on one bank of the Red River and Bossier City on the other, two cities in two parishes that most people treat as one place, and the customers who keep both going come from a wide circle: Caddo and Bossier parishes, East Texas, south Arkansas. A site that only says "Shreveport" leaves out half the people who would drive to you.

Dominion Web Design Pro is Maurice Johnson, building sites by hand in Big Sandy, Texas, on the other side of the state line. You see a free demo first and pay one printed price.

Web design Shreveport LA owners need when the city shrinks but the region holds steady

A KEEL News analysis of Census estimates put Shreveport at about 175,900 people in July 2025, down from about 187,500 in April 2020. Caddo Parish lost about 1,100 residents between 2024 and 2025, the smallest one-year drop since 2020. The whole Shreveport-Bossier City metro, at about 383,000 people, barely changed.

For a small business, that means growth rarely comes from a flood of new neighbors. It comes from winning more of the customers already in the region, including the ones on the far side of the river or the state line. Those people pick between you and a competitor by what they see on a phone, so the site has to answer the basics fast: where you are, which towns you serve, when you are open and how to reach you.

Who brings the money into Shreveport and Bossier

A few big employers and attractions set the pace for everyone else. Each one sends a different kind of customer looking for local businesses.

AnchorWhat the record showsWho it sends your way
Barksdale Air Force BaseHome of the 2nd Bomb Wing, which flies B-52H bombers; the wing's fact sheet counts a workforce of more than 8,500 active duty, reserve and civilian peopleFamilies settling in Bossier who need housing, child care, car repair and a dentist
Willis-Knighton HealthSays it has more than 7,000 employees and calls itself the region's largest nongovernmental employerPatients and families from rural parishes and nearby states who need clear directions and hours

Corridors people name when they give directions

Ask a local where a business is and you will hear a street or a neighborhood before you hear a ZIP code. Highland is a historic neighborhood known for its architecture, parks and restaurants. Line Avenue runs through Highland and South Highlands and is lined with shops, places to eat and antique stores. Youree Drive, farther southeast, is one of the busiest retail roads in the city.

Across the river, East Texas Street, part of U.S. 80 through Bossier City, carries a lot of history. From the 1940s to the 1970s it was the Bossier Strip, an entertainment district of nightclubs, bars and restaurants that drew airmen from Barksdale, and it faded after legal gambling brought casinos to the riverfront in the early 1990s. Today it is a busy commercial road with shops and light industry.

Why should that shape your website? Google says local results depend mostly on relevance, distance and prominence. Someone searching "lawyer near Line Avenue" or "tire shop Bossier" is giving Google a place to measure distance from. If your pages name the corridor you sit on and the areas you cover, you are not asking Google to guess.

A law office near downtown, a clinic off Youree and a contractor in Bossier each need a different page plan. We write it around where your customers really come from, and nobody can promise a ranking, so we will not.

A short drive west, but no office in town

Straight answer on location: Dominion Web Design Pro has no office in Shreveport. Maurice Johnson builds every site from Big Sandy in East Texas and delivers it remotely, by link, phone and email.

Big Sandy is roughly 85 miles west of the Shreveport airport by road, so this is a neighbor writing, not a firm three states away. The work is still remote: you approve every page by link before it goes live.

Starter, at $497, gives a Shreveport or Bossier shop five hand-written pages, a contact form that emails every lead and launch in 7 to 14 days. Pro, at $997, adds ten city pages, handy for a trade that crosses the river and the state line, and an AI chat widget that is free for 14 days, then $297 a month. Agency, at $1,997, starts with keyword research across your area and delivers pages in waves, with the first live inside two weeks; it includes AI phone agent setup, and the agent is free for 7 days, then $297 a month for up to 750 minutes, cancel any time. We do not sell page counts. A strong page for each place that matters beats a pile of thin ones.

Free help on both sides of the Red River

LSBDC Northwest Louisiana

The Louisiana Small Business Development Center office at Southern University Shreveport, on Hilry Huckaby Avenue, gives no-cost, confidential consulting to owners in Caddo, Bossier, De Soto, Red River, Bienville, Webster and Claiborne parishes.

Greater Shreveport Chamber

Founded in 1910 and based on Edwards Street downtown. It lists small business resources and an APEX Accelerator for owners who want government contracts, and says it has more than 1,100 member companies.

Bossier Chamber of Commerce

On Benton Road in Bossier City, with more than 800 members by its own count. Volunteer diplomats call or visit member businesses, and the chamber points owners to workforce programs, including SkillBridge for service members leaving the military.

We are not affiliated with any of them. Each is a good first call for a new or growing business.

Common questions

How much does web design in Shreveport cost?

Shreveport designers mostly quote by the project, so prices are hard to compare. Ours are printed and paid once: Starter is $497 for five hand-written pages, Pro is $997 for ten pages plus ten researched city pages, and Agency is $1,997 for a page for every town and service pair worth targeting. Hosting, maintenance and updates are $49 a month, or included while you keep the AI agent.

Should my website say Shreveport or Bossier City?

Say where you are, then say where you work. They are separate cities in separate parishes, Caddo and Bossier, and people search with the name of their own side. A shop on Youree Drive and a contractor based off East Texas Street both gain from naming the other city too, if they really serve it.

Where is Dominion Web Design Pro located compared to Shreveport?

In Big Sandy, Texas, roughly 85 miles west of the Shreveport airport by road. That is close by Ark-La-Tex standards, but there is no office in Shreveport or Bossier City. Every site is built remotely, and you review it by link, phone and email.

I get customers from East Texas too. Can one web design Shreveport LA project cover both states?

Yes. A city page can be written for Marshall, Longview or Texarkana as easily as for Benton or Haughton, as long as you really serve the place. Pro includes ten of those pages, and Agency starts with keyword research to decide which towns earn one.

Can you build an online store for my Shreveport shop?

Not as part of these packages, and we would rather say so up front. We can build a clear site that shows what you carry, your hours and how to call ahead, which is often what a customer driving in from another parish wants before making the trip.

Want to see your Shreveport site before you spend a dollar?

Give us your business name and what you do, and a demo site gets built for you to look at on your own phone. If you like it, pick a package. If you do not, you have spent nothing but the minute it took to look.
